title: ophiorrhiza pumila var. inflata
intro: Ophiorrhiza pumila var. inflata, commonly known as the Dwarf Woodland Milkwort, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophiorrhiza pumila var. inflata include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimalarial activity, among others. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
